newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Riyadh governor Prince Salman to open a 937.5 million riyal power project on Monday.
- A South African trade team is due to arrive in Saudi Arabia on Sunday.
- A 650-million-riyal sugar refinery to start production in two months.
- A 13-member business team from Spain is due to arrive in Saudi to seek major deals with Saudi firms.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines to start Johannesburg flights from October 28.
